chapter: Multi-Step Word Problems and Logical Reasoning

questions.question: Jay has 12 marbles. He wins 5 more marbles. How many marbles does he have now?
A box contains 20 pencils. 7 pencils are taken out. How many pencils remain?
There are 8 bags with 4 apples in each bag. How many apples are there altogether?
A ribbon is 30 cm long. 12 cm is cut off. How much ribbon remains?
A toy costs $9. You pay with a $10 bill. How much change do you get?
Tom has 24 stickers. He gives 8 stickers to his friend and then buys 6 more. How many stickers does Tom have now?
A bakery made 7 trays of cookies with 8 cookies on each tray. They sold 20 cookies. How many cookies are left?
A bus has 35 passengers. At one stop, 9 get off and 4 get on. How many passengers are now on the bus?
Sara has $25. She buys a book for $8 and a notebook for $5. How much money does she have left?
A rope is 50 meters long. 15 meters are used on Monday and 10 meters on Tuesday. How many meters remain?
Ria has 3 fewer marbles than Tom. Tom has 15 marbles. How many marbles do they have together?
A farmer has 9 baskets with 6 oranges in each basket. He sells 18 oranges. How many oranges are left?
A train traveled 125 miles on Monday and 138 miles on Tuesday. How many miles did it travel in all?
A school collected 325 cans in Week 1 and 278 cans in Week 2. They recycled 150 cans. How many cans remain?
A store received 12 boxes of pencils with 9 pencils in each box. It sold 37 pencils and later received 20 more pencils. How many pencils does the store have now?
